Chapter 1

The number above the desk

1

The first thing Anwen saw each morning was the number above the
newspaper desk. It counted how often students opened the latest edition.
This week it glowed green: 4,812.
‘People are reading us,’ said Dev, the editor.
Anwen wanted that to be true. She had spent three afternoons reporting on
the courtyard’s missing shade. A strip of benches had been removed for a
promotional display, leaving lunchtime queues in the sun.
Her article included photographs, interviews and the school’s explanation. It
also included a question about the building plan. At the bottom of the
edition, it attracted fourteen opens.
Read and circle
Why had the strip of courtyard benches been removed?
A. To make room for a promotional display
B. Because the old benches had become unsafe
C. To give the lunchtime queues more space
